games.name: Wall Hop Practice
games.desc:
Practice Wall Hopping!
🧗 Wall Hopping: Climbing walls by jumping and turning against them. This technique works in any Roblox game to reach otherwise inaccessible areas!

✅ Everything in this game has been tested and is possible!

🖥️ PC
- Set your FPS to 60 in the Roblox settings menu. Higher FPS makes wall hopping much harder
- The alignment keys can be used to wall hop ( , and . )
- Turn on Shift Lock in the Roblox settings menu

🎮 Console
Toggle Shift Lock: Xbox = X, PlayStation = ☐

Please 👍 and ⭐! It really helps!

games.name: Defuse Division
games.desc:
Defuse Division is a team-based objective mode where one side must plant a bomb at a designated site while the other must prevent it or defuse it if planted. The attacking team wins by successfully detonating the bomb or eliminating all opponents, while the defending team wins by stopping the plant, defusing the bomb, or eliminating the attackers before they can complete their objective.

Press N to open the main menu, and M to open the team select menu.

games.name: Unboxing Simulator [UPDATE]
games.desc:
🎁 Welcome to Unboxing Simulator 🎁
Smash boxes, uncover legendary loot, and flex your finds with friends!

[How To Play]
• Open boxes to get hats
• Equip your best hats and weapon to boost damage
• Unlock new worlds, hatch pets, and find even stronger hats
• Visit the Trade Plaza to swap epic items with other players
• Equip perks for powerful effects - some spawn extra boxes, others upgrade or even smash them for you

[Tips]
• Bigger gifts = rarer loot - team up for locked crates!
• Reach Area 3 to hatch pets - pets help you find stronger hats from boxes
• A Locked Crate spawns every 15 min - team up to crack it open for random OP loot like perks or potions

Happy smashing and good luck on the loot!
